The product

Two pieces. One companion.

The lenses read the room. The headpiece speaks to you and reads you. Together they run your personal companion, trained on who you are.

Companion Lenses

  • Reads emotions and body language of the people you talk to
  • Shows subtle cues and conversation starters in your field of view
  • Records moments for your reflection afterwards

Neural Headpiece

  • Bone-conduction audio: your companion talks to you, nobody else hears it
  • Connects to your brain to capture good and difficult emotions
  • Targeted dopamine stimulation in demanding situations
How it works

It learns you first.

For the first 7 days your companion only listens. It learns what kind of person you are, where conversations get hard for you, and how it can help.

Through the lens

Only what helps. Nothing more.

What you see during a conversation: a few quiet signals at the edge of your view. Your eyes stay on the person, not on the interface.

  • OpenHe’s happy to talk. The tag floats above the head, never over the face.
  • He laughed at your jokeWords of affirmation, shown for a few seconds and whispered through the headpiece.
  • Support modeA small marker at the top shows what your companion is doing right now.

Max. 3 signals at a time · always at the edge of your view · nobody but you can see them
